description:
The plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layers. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” with tick labels “Layer1-4”, “Layer5-12”, “Layer13-20”, “Layer21-28”, and “Layer29-32”, representing discrete layer groupings. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” with a linear scale ranging from -25% to 5%, with tick labels at 5% intervals.  

A yellow line, marked with circular data points, represents “LB-Avg of 2xTokens,8-bit”, starting at approximately 2.5% at “Layer1-4” and ending at approximately 1.5% at “Layer29-32”, with a relatively steady trend. A red line, marked with square data points, represents “LB-Avg of 1xTokens,16-bit”, beginning at approximately 2.5% at “Layer1-4” and concluding at approximately 1.5% at “Layer29-32”, also exhibiting a relatively steady trend. A teal line, marked with circular data points, represents “RULER4k of 2xTokens,8-bit”, starting at approximately 2.5% at “Layer1-4” and decreasing to approximately -17.5% at “Layer13-20”, then increasing to approximately -10% at “Layer29-32”. A blue line, marked with square data points, represents “RULER4k of 1xTokens,16-bit”, beginning at approximately 2.5% at “Layer1-4”, decreasing to approximately -25% at “Layer13-20”, and then increasing to approximately -15% at “Layer29-32”.
